notes:
Inbound from YC alumni founders building an embeddable in-app chat layer for B2B product suites. Self-serve signup yesterday; filled basic form and left detailed requirements in onboarding survey. Very latency-sensitive: want streaming / token-by-token for UI; target p95 < 150ms for assistant turn time. Initial scope: help desk triage + contextual suggestions inside product. Prefer hosted initially (self-serve), may move to Dedicated in 6-12 months if growth.

POC asks: sample prompt set (+10), session persistence for KV cache across short flows, function/tool-calling to hit internal search microservice, streaming responses with partial deltas, and deterministic fallback to a smaller model when spikes hit rate limits. Budget: SMB — tight; looking at per-month $500–$1,500 initially.

Security: need SSO (SAML) and audit logs in console. No strict data residency yet but want retention controls and a clear DPA. SOC2 is required by their enterprise customers; they asked if Redwood is SOC2 compliant. Legal asked for a short DPA and a simple security FAQ.

Notes from discovery call (11/14) — paraphrase: "We need crisp turn time inside the product; anything >200ms feels sluggish to our users. Streaming is table stakes for us." CTO: wants to run an A/B comparing Redwood hosted vs. embeddings+re-ranker flow in month 2.

Decision makers: CTO (technical), Head of Product (UX), Ops lead (cost). Technical champion: Senior Engineer Nora Patel (working on integration).

Desired POC success metrics: p95 response latency <150ms, 99% streaming chunk delivery without reconnect, cost per 1k tokens < $1.50 effective after batching.

Quote from Nora: "If we can get consistent streaming and a simple SDK, we'll roll this into the product in Q1."
